title: Raku Workshop
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a raku firing where participants fire their bisque pieces on either November 7th or 15th.
evidence_quote: This is a firing process that is what we like to call "fast and dirty." And the best part? You get to leave with finished pieces!
summary: Public raku workshop on November 7 (1–5 PM) or November 15 (10 AM–2 PM), 2026. Bring up to three bisque-fired pieces no larger than 6 inches; glaze and fire them in rounds. Cost $90.
bring: Up to three bisque-fired pieces no larger than 6 inches in diameter; long-sleeve cotton shirt, close-toed shoes, long pants
how_to_join: Add to cart and register on product page
